description: Increases an existing image's resolution and returns the new job's id immediately (it does NOT wait). Same image, more pixels. WHEN: the user asks to upscale, enhance, sharpen or increase the resolution of a picture they have, including one an earlier `generate_image` returned. It is not how you change what is IN the picture (`generate_image` with the picture as a reference). WHICH MODEL (`upscale_factor` has each one's factors): `topaz-upscale-image` is the general-purpose safe default. `seedvr-upscale-image` is priced by the size of its output. `recraft-creative-upscale-image` decides its own output size and REPAINTS detail: a reinterpretation, not a faithful enlargement. Ask the user when the choice is not obvious. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. COST: this spends the user's tokens, and the three models price differently. `topaz-upscale-image`: 0.32 tokens up to 24 megapixels of OUTPUT, 0.64 up to 48, 1.28 up to 96, 5.44 above that. `seedvr-upscale-image`: 0.025 tokens per output megapixel (a 1024x1024 picture at 4x is about 0.42). `recraft-creative-upscale-image`: a flat 1 token. The image's dimensions are MEASURED BY THE SERVER from the file, never taken from anything you say: that measurement is the price. PNG, JPEG and WebP are readable; anything else (AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, GIF), a picture below the model's minimum size or one whose result would exceed its output limit is REFUSED with nothing charged: re-encode to PNG or JPEG. The `estimate_only` quote is what the job charges. An external url costs one media-ingest slot: quote and create from the SAME url to pay it once. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

model.description: Which upscaler. They differ in price by more than any other setting: use the one the user asked for. REQUIRED: if the user gave none, put your pick and its price in the priced ask; never one chosen to save tokens, never carried over.

source_image.description: URL of the image to upscale. A URL from this account's generations or uploads, or a public https URL (imported first); another account's is refused. A PHOTO FROM THE USER'S OWN MACHINE QUALIFIES: upload it first with `upload_media_widget` (or `upload_media` where no card renders) and pass the url `confirm_upload` returns.

upscale_factor.description: Times larger. topaz: 1, 2 or 4; seedvr: any whole number 1 to 10; recraft takes NONE and REFUSES the request if you send one. Default 2 on the two that take it. A result over the model's output limit is refused before anything is charged. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.
